text: This report provides an update of the Investment Manager fees paid by the Toronto Investment Board for the year ending December 31, 2020. The confidential attachment to this report provides a summary of the fees.

The Toronto Investment Board directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 18, 2021) from the Director, Capital Markets remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information that involves the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
